e: Explanation: Following fertilization in the mosquito's gut, the zygote forms an oocyst on the outer stomach wall. The oocyst ruptures to release thousands of sporozoites, which migrate through the hemolymph to settle in the mosquito's salivary glands, ready for injection into the next human host.

qe: Which specific predatory fish variety is widely introduced into freshwater bodies as a biological control agent to consume mosquito larvae and reduce malaria vectors?
qh: मच्छरों के लार्वा को खाने और मलेरिया वाहकों को कम करने के लिए जैविक नियंत्रण एजेंट के रूप में मीठे पानी के निकायों में किस विशिष्ट शिकारी मछली की किस्म को व्यापक रूप से पेश किया जाता है?
o: Anhydrous pure line trout
Gambusia fish (गैम्बुसिया मछली)
Fluorinated thermoplastic minnows
Cross-linked resin bottom feeders
e: Explanation: Larvivorous fish like *Gambusia* (mosquito fish) are introduced into stagnant water bodies as a biological control method. They feed on mosquito larvae, reducing vector populations safely without chemical pesticides.

qe: Which specific organic compound name details the molecular structure of the primary bark extract derivative used historically to treat active malaria?
qh: सक्रिय मलेरिया के इलाज के लिए ऐतिहासिक रूप से उपयोग किए जाने वाले प्राथमिक छाल अर्क व्युत्पन्न (bark extract derivative) की आणविक संरचना का विवरण देने वाला विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक कौन सा है?
o: Benzoyl variant solution
Quinine / Chloroquine derivatives (कुनैन / क्लोरोक्विन)
Novolac structural liquid paint
Caprolactam cyclic monomer fraction
e: Explanation: Quinine, an alkaloid extracted from the bark of the cinchona tree, has long been used as an antimalarial drug. Modern therapies rely on synthetic derivatives like chloroquine or artemisinin-based combination treatments to target the parasite.

qe: Which micro-environment inside the human body is colonized and disrupted during an infection by the protozoan *Entamoeba histolytica*, causing amoebiasis?
qh: प्रोटोजोअन *Entamoeba histolytica* द्वारा संक्रमण के दौरान मानव शरीर के भीतर कौन सा अंग प्रभावित होता है, जिससे अमीबासिस (amoebiasis) होता है?
o: The deep respiratory alveolar air sacs
The large intestine (बड़ी आंत)
The positive quaternary neural signaling nodes
The linear unbranched cartilage rings of the trachea
e: Explanation: *Entamoeba histolytica* is an intestinal protozoan parasite that causes amoebic dysentery (amoebiasis). It colonizes the mucosal layers of the large intestine, causing ulceration, abdominal pain, and stools containing excess mucus and blood.

qe: Which specific intestinal roundworm is the precise causative pathogen behind human ascariasis, presenting symptoms like internal bleeding and intestinal blockage?
qh: मानव एस्केरियासिस (human ascariasis) के पीछे कौन सा विशिष्ट आंतों का गोलकृमि (roundworm) सटीक कारण रोगजनक है, जो आंतरिक रक्तस्राव और आंतों के रुकावट जैसे लक्षण प्रस्तुत करता है?
o: Wuchereria bancrofti filarial fiber
Ascaris lumbricoides (एस्केरिस लुम्ब्रिकोइड्स)
Meloidogyne incognita root knot worm
Salmonella typhimurium variant
e: Explanation: *Ascaris lumbricoides* is a giant intestinal roundworm and a common helminthic parasite in humans. An infection (ascariasis) can cause internal bleeding, muscular pain, fever, anemia, and blockage of the intestinal passage.

qe: What name is assigned to the chronic helminthic pathology, also known as elephantiasis, characterized by severe inflammation of the lower limbs and lymphatic vessels?
qh: निचले अंगों और लसीका वाहिकाओं (lymphatic vessels) की गंभीर सूजन की विशेषता वाली पुरानी हेल्मिंथिक विकृति, जिसे हाथीपांव (elephantiasis) भी कहा जाता है, को क्या नाम दिया गया है?
o: Amoebic dysentery tract collapse
Filariasis / Elephantiasis (फिपेरियासिस या हाथीपांव)
Ascariasis loop obstruction
Ring-worm skell scaling condition
e: Explanation: Filariasis (or elephantiasis) is a chronic helminthic disease characterized by severe, long-term inflammation and hypertrophy of the lower limbs and genital organs, driven by blockages in the lymphatic vessels.

qe: Which pairing of filarial roundworm parasites is responsible for causing lymphatic filariasis in human populations?
qh: फिपेरियल गोलकृमि परजीवियों (filarial roundworm parasites) की कौन सी जोड़ी मानव आबादी में लसीका फाइलेरिया का कारण बनने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
o: Ascaris lumbricoides and Enterobius lines
Wuchereria bancrofti and Wuchereria malayi (वुचेरेरिया बैनक्रॉफ्टी एवं वुचेरेरिया मलाई)
Entamoeba histolytica and Plasmodium blocks
Microsporum and Trichophyton fungal strings
e: Explanation: Lymphatic filariasis is caused by infection with filarial nematodes belonging to the genus *Wuchereria*, specifically *Wuchereria bancrofti* and *Wuchereria malayi*.

qe: Which specific operational vector is responsible for transmitting the filarial larvae of *Wuchereria bancrofti* into human hosts?
qh: *Wuchereria bancrofti* के फाइलेरिया लार्वा को मानव मेजबानों में प्रसारित करने के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट वाहक जिम्मेदार है?
o: Female Aedes mosquito channels
Female Culex mosquito (मादा क्यूलेक्स मच्छर)
Female Anopheles mosquito tracking lines
Male tsetse fly structural frameworks
e: Explanation: The filarial worms *Wuchereria bancrofti* are transmitted into human hosts through the bite of an infected female *Culex* mosquito vector.

qe: What direct morphological symptom defines a classic ringworm skin infection, making it highly recognizable?
qh: एक क्लासिक दाद (ringworm) त्वचा संक्रमण को कौन सा प्रत्यक्ष रूपात्मक लक्षण परिभाषित करता है, जिससे यह अत्यधिक पहचान योग्य हो जाता है?
o: The spontaneous liquefaction of tissue layers into loose amides
The appearance of dry, scales, and intense lesions accompanied by severe itching across skin, nails, and scalp (त्वचा पर सूखे, पपड़ीदार घाव और तेज खुजली)
The transformation of skin layers into linear synthetic polyamides
Spontaneous free-radical addition reactions that cause localized structural hardening
e: Explanation: Ringworm (tinea) is a fungal skin infection characterized by the appearance of dry, scaly circular lesions on the skin, nails, or scalp, accompanied by intense itching.

qe: Which specific trio of fungal genera contains the primary pathogens responsible for causing ringworm infections in humans?
qh: कवक जेनेरा (fungal genera) के किस विशिष्ट तिकड़ी में मनुष्यों में दाद के संक्रमण के लिए जिम्मेदार प्राथमिक रोगजनक शामिल हैं?
o: Plasmodium, Entamoeba, and Ascaris groups
Microsporum, Trichophyton, and Epidermofytton (माइक्रोस्पोरम, ट्राइकोफाइटन एवं एपिडर्मोफाइटन)
Wuchereria, Bacillus, and Salmonella clusters
Rhizopus, Agaricus, and Saccharomyces variants
e: Explanation: Ringworm infections are caused by a group of dermatophyte fungi belonging to three primary genera: *Microsporum*, *Trichophyton*, and *Epidermophyton*.

qe: What terminology defines the defensive system of immunity that is present from birth, offering non-specific protection against invading pathogens?
qh: प्रतिरक्षा की उस रक्षात्मक प्रणाली (defensive system of immunity) को क्या शब्दावली परिभाषित करती है जो जन्म से मौजूद होती है, जो आक्रमणकारी रोगजनकों के खिलाफ गैर-विशिष्ट सुरक्षा प्रदान करती है?
o: Acquired explicit memory network
Innate Immunity (सहज / जन्मजात प्रतिरक्षा)
Polycistronic operon barrier channel
Thermosetting cross-linked antibody mesh
e: Explanation: Innate immunity is an organism's baseline defense infrastructure. Present from birth, it provides non-specific protection against pathogens through immediate physical, chemical, and cellular barriers.

qe: What parameter structural descriptor captures the primary operational behavior of an acquired immunity response?
qh: कौन सा पैरामीटर संरचनात्मक विवरण एक उपार्जित प्रतिरक्षा (acquired immunity) प्रतिक्रिया के प्राथमिक परिचालन व्यवहार को कैप्चर करता है?
o: It is entirely non-specific and lacks any internal sugar components
It is highly pathogen-specific and is characterized by a distinct immunological memory configuration (रोगजनक-विशिष्ट होना और स्मृति आधारित होना)
It coordinates exclusively via linear unbranched caprolactam links
It breaks down completely when exposed to standard room temperature shifts
e: Explanation: Unlike innate immunity, acquired (adaptive) immunity develops over time through antigen exposure. It is highly pathogen-specific and creates immunological memory cells that recognize and mount a rapid, targeted attack if the same pathogen invades again.

qe: What unique physical option parameters detail the composition of the 'cytokine barriers' encountered inside innate defense networks?
qh: सहज रक्षा नेटवर्क (innate defense networks) के भीतर आने वाले 'साइटोकाइन बाधाओं' (cytokine barriers) की संरचना का विवरण कौन सा विशिष्ट भौतिक विकल्प देता है?
o: The structural layout of tightly sealed epidermal skin lines
Interferon proteins secreted by virus-infected cells to shield adjacent uninfected cells from viral replication (वायरस संक्रमित कोशिकाओं द्वारा स्रावित इंटरफेरॉन प्रोटीन)
The concentrated pooling of acidic hydrochloric juices within stomach wells
The presence of flexible biological disulfide links across cartilage sheets
e: Explanation: Cytokine barriers are chemical signaling networks. For example, virus-infected cells secrete proteins called interferons, which bind to adjacent, uninfected cells and stimulate the synthesis of antiviral proteins, protecting them from viral replication.

qe: What nomenclature describes the swift, highly amplified immune response executed by the acquired defense network upon a second encounter with an identical pathogen?
qh: एक ही रोगजनक के साथ दूसरी मुठभेड़ पर उपार्जित रक्षा नेटवर्क (acquired defense network) द्वारा निष्पादित तीव्र, अत्यधिक प्रवर्धित प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया को क्या नाम दिया गया है?
o: Primary low-intensity initialization threshold
Secondary or Anamnestick response (द्वितीयक या एनामनेस्टिक अनुक्रिया / Secondary response)
Homolytic radical chain propagation phase
Monomeric ring-opening addition loop cycle
e: Explanation: The first exposure to a pathogen triggers a slow, low-intensity primary immune response. A second encounter with the same pathogen triggers a rapid, highly amplified secondary or anamnestick response, driven by the activation of memory cells.

qe: Which specific architectural layout holds the four polypeptide chains together inside a standard structural molecule of an antibody?
qh: एक एंटीबॉडी के एक मानक संरचनात्मक अणु के भीतर चार पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखलाओं को एक साथ कौन सा विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक लेआउट रखता है?
o: Symmetrical glycosidic links crossing pentose sugars
Covalent disulfide bonds linking heavy and light chains ($H_2L_2$ संरचना में डाइसल्फाइड बंध)
Alternating phosphodiester bridging centers running along rings
Weak van der Waals attraction fields tracking along tail ends
e: Explanation: An antibody molecule is a Y-shaped glycoprotein composed of four polypeptide chains: two identical heavy chains ($H$) and two identical light chains ($L$), designated as an $H_2L_2$ structure. These chains are linked and stabilized by covalent disulfide bonds ($-S-S-$).

qe: What unique structural domain name specifies the physical antigen-binding site located at the amino-terminal tips of an antibody molecule?
qh: एंटीबॉडी अणु के अमीनो-टर्मिनल सिरों पर स्थित भौतिक एंटीजन-बाइंडिंग साइट (antigen-binding site) को कौन सा अनूठा संरचनात्मक डोमेन नाम निर्दिष्ट करता है?
o: Epitope structural tag segment
Paratope (पैराटोप / एंटीजन-बाइंडिंग साइट)
Unbranched polyolefin tail matrix center
Thermosetting cross-linked coordination node slot
e: Explanation: The antigen-binding domain located at the variable, amino-terminal tips of an antibody's heavy and light chains is called a paratope. The paratope recognizes and binds to a specific structural site on an antigen, known as an epitope.

qe: Which specific immunoglobulin class is uniquely optimized to cross across the human placenta to transfer passive immunity from a mother to her developing fetus?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट इम्युनोग्लोबुलिन वर्ग (immunoglobulin class) माँ से उसके विकासशील भ्रूण में निष्क्रिय प्रतिरक्षा स्थानांतरित करने के लिए मानव नाल (placenta) को पार करने के लिए विशिष्ट रूप से अनुकूलित है?
o: IgA secretory variant templates
IgG antibody class (आईजीजी / IgG एंटीबॉडी)
IgM heavy macro variant strings
IgE allergic tracking structural markers
e: Explanation: IgG is the smallest and most abundant class of immunoglobulins. Its compact structural configuration allows it to cross the placental barrier, transferring maternal passive immunity to protect the developing fetus.

qe: What name is assigned to the early, nutrient-dense yellowish milk fluid secreted by a mother during the initial days of lactation, which is rich in IgA antibodies?
qh: स्तनपान के शुरुआती दिनों में मां द्वारा स्रावित होने वाले शुरुआती, पोषक तत्वों से भरपूर पीले दूध के तरल पदार्थ को क्या नाम दिया गया है, जो IgA एंटीबॉडी से समृद्ध होता है?
o: Saponified lipid composite fluid
Colostrum (कोलास्ट्रम / पीयूष)
Linear thermoplastic Novolac suspension syrup
Anhydrous unbranched protein hydrolysate solution
e: Explanation: Colostrum is the thick, yellowish milk fluid secreted by the mammary glands during the first few days after childbirth. It contains high concentrations of secretory IgA antibodies, providing immediate passive immunity to protect the newborn infant's gut.

qe: Which specific category of immune cells drives the 'cell-mediated immunity' (CMI) response, responsible for graft rejections in tissue transplantations?
qh: प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाओं की कौन सी विशिष्ट श्रेणी 'सेल-मध्यस्थता प्रतिरक्षा' (cell-mediated immunity) प्रतिक्रिया को संचालित करती है, जो ऊतक प्रत्यारोपण में ग्राफ्ट अस्वीकृति के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
o: B-lymphocytes manufacturing immunoglobulins
T-lymphocytes / T-cells (टी-लिम्फोसाइट्स / टी-कोशिकाएं)
Non-nucleated blood platelet cells
Linear unbranched polysaccharide builders
e: Explanation: Cell-mediated immunity (CMI) does not rely on circulating antibodies; instead, it is driven by specialized T-lymphocytes (T-cells). Cytotoxic T-cells scan, identify, and destroy foreign or non-self cells, making them responsible for tissue graft rejection.

qe: What complex cellular multiprotein assembly incorporates an siRNA strand to target and slice complementary mRNA molecules inside the cytoplasm?
qh: कौन सा जटिल सेलुलर मल्टीप्रोटीन असेंबली साइटोप्लाज्म के भीतर पूरक mRNA अणुओं को लक्षित करने और काटने के लिए एक siRNA स्ट्रैंड को शामिल करता है?
o: Ziegler-Natta coordination template polymerization system
RISC / RNA-Induced Silencing Complex (रिस्क कॉम्प्लेक्स / RISC)
The human spliceosome intron-cleaving network mapping model
A cross-linked urea-formaldehyde polymer matrix sheet
e: Explanation: In RNA interference (RNAi), small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) are integrated into a multi-protein assembly called the RNA-Induced Silencing Complex (RISC). RISC unwinds the siRNA, uses one strand as a guide to locate complementary mRNA, and cleaves it, blocking translation.

qe: What formal operational name is assigned to chemical modifiers that reduce the baseline rate of a chemical reaction without necessarily interacting with a solid catalyst surface?
qh: उन रासायनिक संशोधकों को क्या औपचारिक परिचालन नाम दिया गया है जो ठोस उत्प्रेरक सतह के साथ बातचीत किए बिना रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया की आधार दर को कम करते हैं?
o: Reaction promoters and chemical activators
Inhibitors or Retarders (अशमंदक / मंदक)
Cationic quaternary ammonium halide variants
Inorganic dicarboxylic alkaline matrix builders
e: Explanation: Inhibitors (or retarders) are substances that decrease the rate of a chemical reaction by interacting with reagents or intermediates, slowing down the reaction pathway (e.g., acetanilide stabilizing hydrogen peroxide decomposition).

qe: The single-stranded backbones of DNA and RNA molecules are constructed by linking successive nucleotides via which strong covalent bonds?
qh: DNA और RNA अणुओं की एकल-स्ट्रैंडेड रीढ़ क्रमिक न्यूक्लियोटाइड को किस मजबूत सहसंयोजक बंध द्वारा जोड़कर बनाई जाती है?
o: Glycosidic connections bridging sugar rings together
Phosphodiester linkages (फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध / लिंक)
Methylene amide coordinate connection networks across strands
Disulfide cross-link bridges pulling hydrocarbon chain links
e: Explanation: The backbones of DNA and RNA are compiled by connecting successive nucleotides via strong covalent phosphodiester bonds that link the C5' position of one pentose ring to the C3' position of the next.

qe: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), which parameter configuration represents the most accurate definition of health?
qh: विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन (WHO) के अनुसार, स्वास्थ्य (health) की सबसे सटीक परिभाषा कौन सी है?
o: Health is a balanced physical status avoiding chemical toxins
Health is a state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being (पूर्ण शारीरिक, मानसिक और सामाजिक कल्याण की स्थिति)
Health is the unique baseline reflection of a smiling face
Health is directly equivalent to economic prosperity metrics
e: Explanation: Health does not merely mean the absence of disease or structural physical fitness. It is standardly defined as a complete state of physical, mental, and social well-being that optimizes an individual's longevity and work efficiency.

qe: What precise descriptive name is assigned to biological agents like bacteria, viruses, fungi, and protozoans that actively induce diseases within a host?
qh: बैक्टीरिया, वायरस, कवक और प्रोटोजोअन जैसे जैविक एजेंटों को क्या नाम दिया जाता है जो सक्रिय रूप से मेजबान के भीतर बीमारियों का कारण बनते हैं?
o: Pathogens (रोगजनक / पैथोजन)
Insect vectors
Oligomeric carriers
Resin modifiers
e: Explanation: Any disease-causing biological organism is classified under the structural category of a pathogen. Biological vectors, on the other hand, function as active carriers that transport these pathogens between host setups.

qe: Which specific chemical agglutination test is standardly performed in pathology laboratories to diagnose a suspected case of typhoid fever?
qh: टाइफाइड बुखार (typhoid fever) के संदिग्ध मामले की पुष्टि करने के लिए प्रयोगशालाओं में कौन सा विशिष्ट रासायनिक परीक्षण किया जाता है?
o: ELISA diagnostic screening
ESR blood settling test
PCR sequence amplification
Widal test (विडाल टेस्ट)
e: Explanation: Typhoid fever, caused by the bacterium *Salmonella typhi*, is standardly confirmed through the Widal test, which identifies specific antibodies in the patient's serum.

qe: From the listed physical clinical conditions, select the group that represents exclusively infectious communicable pathologies.
qh: दी गई सूची में से केवल संक्रामक या संचरणीय रोगों (infectious communicable diseases) के समूह की पहचान कीजिए।
o: Cancer and common Allergy matrices
Influenza and Smallpox (इन्फ्लूएंजा एवं चेचक / स्मॉलपॉक्स)
Allergy and localized cancer tracks
Rheumatoid arthritis and vascular tumors
e: Explanation: Influenza (caused by influenza viruses) and Smallpox (caused by the *Variola virus*) are highly contagious infectious diseases. Cancer and allergies represent non-infectious physiological responses.

qe: Where inside the biological systems of an infected female *Anopheles* mosquito do *Plasmodium* gametes undergo fertilization and initial multiplication?
qh: एक संक्रमित मादा *Anopheles* मच्छर के शरीर के भीतर *Plasmodium* युग्मकों (gametes) का निषेचन और प्रारंभिक गुणन कहाँ होता है?
o: Inside the primary human liver cells
Within the mature red blood cells of the host
In the stomach wall/gut lumen of the mosquito vector (मच्छर की आंत/पेट की दीवार में)
Inside the anterior salivary gland fluid cavities
e: Explanation: Fertilization and initial development of the malaria parasite take place inside the gut lumen/stomach wall of the female *Anopheles* mosquito. The resulting mature sporozoites then migrate to reside inside its salivary glands.

qe: What toxic crystalline compound is released into the human bloodstream when *Plasmodium* merozoites rupture erythrocytes, causing recurring chills and shivering?
qh: जब *Plasmodium* परजीवी मानव लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं को तोड़ते हैं, तो रक्तप्रवाह में कौन सा विषाक्त पदार्थ जारी होता है, जिससे कंपकंपी के साथ बार-बार बुखार आता है?
o: Serotonin alignment fluid
Haemozoin (हीमोजोइन)
Histamine inflammatory ester
Tannic acid chemical derivative
e: Explanation: The breakdown of blood hemoglobin by multiplying blood-stage parasites releases a toxic crystalline pigment known as haemozoin. This compound triggers the periodic chills and high recurring fevers characteristic of malaria.

qe: Which specific viral vector represents the primary operational driver that transmits Dengue fever and Chikungunya into human hosts?
qh: डेंगू बुखार (Dengue fever) और चिकनगुनिया को मानव मेजबान में प्रसारित करने वाला प्राथमिक कीट वाहक कौन सा है?
o: Common house flies
Aedes mosquitoes (एडीज मच्छर)
Cockroach structural vectors
Female Anopheles mosquitoes
e: Explanation: Viral diseases like Dengue and Chikungunya are standardly transmitted into human hosts via the bite of an infected female *Aedes* mosquito.

qe: Which precise group of clinical symptoms serves as a landmark diagnostic indicator confirming an infection of human pneumonia?
qh: लक्षणों का कौन सा समूह मानव निमोनिया (pneumonia) के संक्रमण की पुष्टि करने वाला प्रमुख नैदानिक संकेतक है?
o: Difficulty in respiration accompanied by fever, chills, and cough (सांस लेने में कठिनाई, बुखार, ठंड लगना और खांसी)
Chronic constipation, abdominal pain, and structural cramps
Nasal congestion, continuous watery discharge, and mild sore throat
High fever, stomach ulcers, and absolute loss of appetite
e: Explanation: Pneumonia, naturally caused by *Streptococcus pneumoniae*, compromises pulmonary air sacs. This leads to distinct respiratory distress, difficulty breathing, a severe cough, chills, and fever.

qe: What formal term defines the internal cellular genes that natively exist in an inactive state but can transform into cancer-causing oncogenes upon mutation?
qh: उन आंतरिक कोशिकीय जीनों (cellular genes) को क्या कहा जाता है जो सामान्यतः निष्क्रिय अवस्था में रहते हैं लेकिन उत्परिवर्तन होने पर कैंसर का कारण बन सकते हैं?
o: Structural alignment sequences
Proto-oncogenes / Cellular oncogenes (प्रोटो-ऑन्कोजीन / कोशिकीय ऑन्कोजीन)
Expressor sequence segments
Regulatory operon nodes
e: Explanation: Normal somatic cell genomes contain genes designated as cellular oncogenes ($c\text{-onc}$) or proto-oncogenes. Under the influence of structural mutations or environmental carcinogens, these transition into active oncogenes, causing uncontrolled cell division.

qe: What descriptive terminology defines the dangerous lifecycle stage where malignant tumor cells detach, migrate via blood streams, and establish secondary tumors across distant organs?
qh: घातक ट्यूमर कोशिकाओं (malignant tumor cells) के रक्तप्रवाह के माध्यम से शरीर के दूरस्थ अंगों में फैलने और नए ट्यूमर बनाने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: Metagenesis alternation
Metastasis (मेटास्टेसिस)
Teratogenesis toxicity
Mitotic index scaling
e: Explanation: Malignant tumors exhibit a dangerous operational characteristic known as metastasis. Proliferating cancer cells invade neighboring blood vessels and travel to distant sites to spawn new secondary tumors.

qe: When an individual displays persistent behavioral and social maladjustments despite lacking physical symptoms, what classification describes their clinical health state?
qh: जब कोई व्यक्ति शारीरिक लक्षणों की कमी के बावजूद लगातार व्यवहारिक और सामाजिक रूप से तालमेल नहीं बिठा पाता है, तो मनोचिकित्सक के अनुसार उनका स्वास्थ्य कैसा है?
o: The individual is locked in an economically unprosperous state
The individual is diagnosed as mentally or socially unhealthy due to psychological discomfort (व्यवहारिक और सामाजिक कुसमायोजन के कारण अस्वस्थ)
The individual requires immediate free-radical polyolefin updates
The profile marks an absolute lack of athletic training metrics
e: Explanation: Health is a complete state of physical, mental, and social well-being. A psychiatric diagnosis of poor health often stems from behavioral anomalies, emotional distress, or social maladjustment, even if the person appears physically fit.

qe: Which specific underlying cellular event characterizes the onset of an autoimmune disease like rheumatoid arthritis?
qh: रुमेटॉइड आर्थराइटिस (rheumatoid arthritis) जैसे ऑटो-इम्यून रोग की शुरुआत किस विशिष्ट कोशिकीय घटना के कारण होती है?
o: The absolute deactivation of all circulating lymphocytes
The immune system loses its ability to differentiate foreign molecules from self-cells, attacking the body's own tissues (प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र द्वारा स्वयं की कोशिकाओं पर हमला करना)
The sudden over-production of non-specific volatile amides
The complete cross-linking of structural alpha-helix channels
e: Explanation: Autoimmunity occurs when the host's immune infrastructure loses self-tolerance. It fails to distinguish foreign pathogens from self-molecules, causing circulating lymphocytes to actively attack and destroy the body's own tissues, as seen in rheumatoid arthritis.

qe: Which social and physical interaction is completely safe and does not serve as a mode of transmission for the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सामाजिक या शारीरिक संपर्क ह्यूमन इम्युनोडेफिशिएंसी वायरस (HIV) के संचरण का माध्यम नहीं है?
o: Transfusion of contaminated blood plasma batches
Sharing contaminated needles among intravenous users
Shaking hands or standard casual contact with an infected individual (संक्रमित व्यक्ति से हाथ मिलाना या सामान्य संपर्क)
Unprotected sexual contact with a diagnosed individual
e: Explanation: HIV is a blood-borne virus that requires direct exchange of bodily fluids (blood, semen, vaginal secretions) or vertical transmission via the placenta. It is completely absent from casual environmental interactions like shaking hands, hugging, or sharing utensils.

qe: What is the biochemical identity and microbial origin of the addictive narcotic drug commonly known as 'smack'?
qh: आमतौर पर 'स्मैक' (smack) के रूप में जानी जाने वाली मादक दवा की जैव रासायनिक पहचान और उसका पादप स्रोत क्या है?
o: Diacetylmorphine obtained by acetylation of morphine extracted from the latex of *Papaver somniferum* (पापावर सोमनिफेरम के लेटेक्स से प्राप्त डायसिटाइलमोर्फिन)
Cannabinoid structures extracted from the green leaves of *Cannabis sativa*
Tropane alkaloids harvested from the young flowers of *Datura pinata*
Cocaine base refined from the Young fruits of *Erythroxylum coca*
e: Explanation: 'Smack' is the common name for heroin, which is chemically diacetylmorphine. It is synthesized by processing and acetylating morphine molecules harvested from the raw latex fluid of the poppy plant, *Papaver somniferum*.

qe: Which specialized cytokine protein group is naturally synthesized and secreted by virus-infected cells to shield neighboring uninfected cells from further viral replication?
qh: वायरस से संक्रमित कोशिकाओं द्वारा कौन सा विशिष्ट साइटोकाइन प्रोटीन समूह प्राकृतिक रूप से स्रावित होता है जो स्वस्थ कोशिकाओं को संक्रमण से बचाता है?
o: Serotonin tracking fluid
Colostrum immune factor
Interferons (इंटरफेरॉन)
Histamine inflammatory ester
e: Explanation: Interferons are cytokine barrier molecules secreted by host cells following viral invasion. They bind to neighboring uninfected cells, triggering the synthesis of antiviral enzymes that halt subsequent viral transcription and translation loops.

qe: What primary category of acquired immune response is directly responsible for the rejection of foreign tissue grafts and transplanted organs?
qh: ऊतक प्रत्यारोपण (tissue transplantations) में विदेशी ग्राफ्ट और प्रत्यारोपित अंगों की अस्वीकृति के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया जिम्मेदार होती है?
o: Auto-immune baseline shock
Humoral antibody-mediated immunity
Physiological barrier exclusion profiles
Cell-mediated immune response driven by T-lymphocytes (टी-लिम्फोसाइट्स द्वारा संचालित सेल-मध्यस्थता प्रतिरक्षा)
e: Explanation: Organ transplant rejections are driven by cell-mediated immunity (CMI). Specialized T-lymphocytes recognize foreign major histocompatibility complex (MHC) surface markers on the graft as non-self, launching a targeted cytotoxic attack to reject the organ.

qe: Which predominant class of immunoglobulins is packed heavily inside a mother's colostrum to supply passive immunity to her newborn infant?
qh: नवजात शिशु को निष्क्रिय प्रतिरक्षा (passive immunity) प्रदान करने के लिए माँ के कोलोस्ट्रम (colostrum) में कौन सा इम्युनोग्लोबुलिन वर्ग प्रचुर मात्रा में होता है?
o: IgG serum configuration
IgA type (आईजीए / IgA प्रकार)
IgD surface indicator
IgE hypersensitivity factor
e: Explanation: The yellowish fluid colostrum contains a high concentration of secretory IgA antibodies. This provides immediate passive immunity, coating the newborn's gastrointestinal tract to protect against pathogenic invasions.

qe: Which alkaloid component present in tobacco blends triggers the immediate release of adrenaline and noradrenaline, expanding heart rate and blood pressure parameters?
qh: तंबाकू के मिश्रण में मौजूद कौन सा अल्कलॉइड घटक एड्रेनालाईन और नोरएड्रेनालाईन के स्राव को उत्तेजित करता है, जिससे हृदय गति और रक्तचाप बढ़ जाता है?
o: Nicotine (निकोटिन)
Tannic acid matrix
Curcumin chemical derivative
Catechin antioxidant fraction
e: Explanation: Tobacco contains the psychoactive alkaloid nicotine. Nicotine stimulates the adrenal medulla to secrete adrenaline and noradrenaline into the bloodstream, which activates the sympathetic nervous system to increase blood pressure and heart rate.

qe: What biochemical component is explicitly packed inside clinical antivenom formulations deployed to neutralize lethal snake venom inside an endangered patient?
qh: सांप के जहर को बेअसर करने के लिए नैदानिक एंटीवेनम (antivenom) फॉर्मूलेशन के भीतर कौन सा जैव रासायनिक घटक विशेष रूप से पैक किया जाता है?
o: Attenuated snake antigens
Antigen-antibody combined complexes
Pre-formed antibodies specific to the venom toxins (विशिष्ट एंटीबॉडीज)
Active proteolytic clearing enzymes
e: Explanation: Antivenom provides artificial passive immunity. It contains pre-formed, venom-neutralizing antibodies harvested from hyper-immunized host animals (like horses or sheep). These antibodies bind and neutralize the venom toxins immediately upon injection.

qe: Which human biological gland is characteristically large and highly active at birth but undergoes systematic reduction and atrophy with advanced aging?
qh: कौन सी मानव ग्रंथि जन्म के समय बड़े आकार की और अत्यधिक सक्रिय होती है, लेकिन बढ़ती उम्र के साथ व्यवस्थित रूप से आकार में छोटी (atrophy) हो जाती है?
o: Pineal matrix center
Pituitary master pocket
Thymus gland (थाइमस ग्रंथि)
Thyroid metabolic framework
e: Explanation: The thymus is a primary lymphoid organ situated near the heart. It is quite prominent at birth to establish the T-lymphocyte repertoire but undergoes progressive age-associated involution, shrinking significantly after puberty.

qe: What operational milestone describes the primary difference between an active immunization process and a passive immunization workflow?
qh: सक्रिय प्रतिरक्षण (active immunization) और निष्क्रिय प्रतिरक्षण (passive immunization) के बीच मुख्य परिचालन अंतर क्या है?
o: Active processes rely entirely on high-pressure metal coordinate injections

Active immunization forces the host's own body to synthesize antibodies against an antigen, while passive immunization delivers ready-made antibodies directly (सक्रिय में शरीर स्वयं एंटीबॉडी बनाता है, निष्क्रिय में बाहर से दी जाती है)
Active setups decrease the structural density of cell wall proteins to zero
There is no shared clinical metric; both represent identical addition systems
e: Explanation: Active immunization introduces an antigen (like a vaccine) to prompt the host's immune system to synthesize its own antibodies and establish long-lived memory cells. Passive immunization bypasses this timeline by delivering pre-formed antibodies directly, supplying immediate but temporary protection.

qe: Which specific cell line serves as the native cellular site where the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) aggressively replicates, acting as an industrial 'factory' inside the host?
qh: ह्यूमन इम्युनोडेफिशिएंसी वायरस (HIV) मेजबान के भीतर किस विशिष्ट कोशिका रेखा (cell line) में आक्रामक रूप से प्रतिकृति बनाता है, जो वायरस की फैक्ट्री के रूप में कार्य करती है?
o: Anucleated mature red blood cells
Macrophages and Helper T-cells ($T_H$ cells) (मैक्रोफेज एवं हेल्पर टी-कोशिकाएं)
Cationic platelets floating in serum reservoirs
Bone marrow structural fibroblasts
e: Explanation: Upon entering the body, HIV targets cells displaying CD4 surface receptors, primarily invading macrophages and helper T-lymphocytes ($T_H$ cells). The viral RNA is reverse-transcribed into DNA, turning these cells into replication factories that churn out new viral particles.

qe: What precise change in the immune cell population matrix explains why advanced AIDS patients succumb to mild opportunistic infections like *Mycobacterium* or fungal invasions?
qh: एड्स के रोगी माइकोबैक्टीरियम या कवक जैसे सामान्य संक्रमणों के प्रति भी संवेदनशील क्यों हो जाते हैं, इसका क्या कारण है?
o: The sudden spontaneous precipitation of all plasma albumins
A drastic, systematic drop in the absolute count of functional Helper T-lymphocytes ($T_H$ cells) (हेल्पर टी-कोशिकाओं की संख्या में भारी गिरावट)
The direct conversion of bone marrow into an anhydrous polyolefin tail layer
The complete cross-linking of structural antibody links via stable single bonds
e: Explanation: HIV destroys helper T-lymphocytes ($T_H$ cells). As the disease progresses, the absolute count of these critical cells drops drastically. Because helper T-cells are required to activate both humoral and cell-mediated immune responses, their loss leaves the body vulnerable to minor opportunistic infections.

qe: Which multi-protein cell assembly is systematically targeted and bound by the gp120 surface glycoprotein of an invading HIV virion to gain host entry?
qh: मेजबान कोशिका में प्रवेश करने के लिए HIV का gp120 सरफेस ग्लाइकोप्रोटीन मुख्य रूप से किस विशिष्ट सेलुलर रिसेप्टर को लक्षित करता है और उससे जुड़ता है?
o: The primary insulin receptor domain
The CD4 receptor site displayed on T-helper cells and macrophages (CD4 रिसेप्टर साइट)
The unbranched non-ionic polyolefin network
The rigid cross-linked Bakelite structural node
e: Explanation: The gp120 envelope glycoprotein of HIV has a strong binding affinity for the CD4 receptor molecules displayed on the surface membranes of helper T-cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells, utilizing them as entry portals.

qe: What name is assigned to the legal and national administrative framework established by the Government of India to lead and coordinate anti-HIV awareness campaigns across the country?
qh: भारत सरकार द्वारा देश भर में एंटी-HIV जागरूकता अभियानों का नेतृत्व और समन्वय करने के लिए स्थापित प्रशासनिक ढांचे को क्या नाम दिया गया है?
o: The Genetic Engineering Approval Committee
NACO / National AIDS Control Organization (नाको / NACO)
The Ground Environment Action Council
The Gibbs Free Energy Regulatory Committee
e: Explanation: In India, national efforts to manage, monitor, and spread education regarding HIV transmission are spearheaded by the National AIDS Control Organization (NACO), alongside various non-governmental organizations (NGOs).

qe: What cellular interaction behavior is completely lost when normal somatic cells undergo transformation into highly malignant cancer cells?
qh: जब सामान्य दैहिक कोशिकाएं (somatic cells) अत्यधिक घातक कैंसर कोशिकाओं में बदल जाती हैं, तो कौन सा विशिष्ट कोशिकीय व्यवहार पूरी तरह से समाप्त हो जाता है?
o: The homolytic cleavage of carbon-carbon single bonds
Contact Inhibition (संपर्क संदमन / कांटेक्ट इनहिबिशन)
The synthesis of linear synthetic polyamide strings
The baseline capacity to bind negative phosphate matrices
e: Explanation: Normal somatic cells display a regulatory behavior known as contact inhibition: when they grow and clear physical contact with neighboring cells, their replication loops cease. Cancer cells lose this property, dividing continuously to form irregular cell masses called tumors.

qe: Which high-precision diagnostic imaging strategy utilizes non-ionizing magnetic fields and radiofrequency waves to generate safe 3D maps of internal tissue pathologies without radiation risks?
qh: कौन सी उच्च-सटीक नैदानिक इमेजिंग रणनीति विकिरण जोखिमों के बिना आंतरिक ऊतक विकृतियों के सुरक्षित 3D मानचित्र उत्पन्न करने के लिए चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों और रेडियो तरंगों का उपयोग करती है?
o: Standard computed tomography (CT) scanning loops
MRI / Magnetic Resonance Imaging (एमआरआई / MRI)
The basic free-radical benzoyl peroxide indicator scan
The unbranched starch verification matrix chart
e: Explanation: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) uses strong, non-ionizing magnetic fields and radiofrequency pulses to generate highly detailed three-dimensional structural profiles of soft tissues, making it an exceptional diagnostic tool for locating internal tumors safely.

qe: What primary operational drawback limits the diagnostic sensitivity of old, conventional serum and urine analysis tests compared to modern molecular tools like PCR?
qh: आधुनिक आणविक उपकरणों (जैसे PCR) की तुलना में पारंपरिक सीरम और मूत्र विश्लेषण परीक्षणों की नैदानिक संवेदनशीलता को कौन सी मुख्य परिचालन कमी सीमित करती है?
o: They completely convert passing elements into volatile gases
They completely fail to enable early detection because pathogens must multiply to massive quantities before clinical signs register (प्रारंभिक अवस्था में रोग की पहचान करने में असमर्थ होना)
They rely exclusively on toxic arsenic cross-linked bridges
They freeze cell wall structures into an uncharged polymer matrix
e: Explanation: Conventional testing methods (such as basic urinalysis or serological screens) cannot achieve early detection. They require the pathogen to reach high concentrations or manifest structural symptoms before testing positive, missing the window for early intervention.

qe: Which specific psychoactive alkaloid component present in tobacco products acts as a strong chemical stimulant targeting the human adrenal medulla?
qh: तंबाकू उत्पादों में मौजूद कौन सा विशिष्ट साइकोएक्टिव अल्कलॉइड घटक मानव एड्रिनल मेडुला को लक्षित करने वाले एक मजबूत रासायनिक उत्तेजक के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Morphine base crystal fractions
Nicotine (निकोटिन)
Cannabinoid open chain resins
Lyserigic acid diethyl derivatives
e: Explanation: Tobacco consumption introduces nicotine into the host. Nicotine acts directly as a chemical stimulant on the nicotinic receptors of the adrenal medulla, triggering the systemic release of catecholamines (adrenaline and noradrenaline).

qe: What dangerous gas molecule builds up inside the bloodstream of a chronic tobacco smoker, directly displacing oxygen from binding sites along hemoglobin backbones?
qh: क्रोनिक तंबाकू धूम्रपान करने वाले के रक्तप्रवाह के भीतर कौन सा खतरनाक गैस अणु बनता है, जो हीमोग्लोबिन के साथ ऑक्सीजन के जुड़ने को विस्थापित करता है?
o: Pure nitrogen gas fumes
Carbon Monoxide / CO (कार्बन मोनोऑक्साइड / CO)
Volatile petroleum ether gas fractions
Fluorinated vinylic addition monomers
e: Explanation: Tobacco smoke contains high volumes of Carbon Monoxide ($CO$). Carbon monoxide binds to the iron centers of hemoglobin with an affinity over 200 times stronger than oxygen. This creates carboxyhemoglobin, reducing oxygen-carrying capacity across the cardiovascular system.

qe: Where inside the complex structural map of a transfer RNA (tRNA) adapter molecule are the triplet bases located that pair antiparallelly with matching mRNA codons?
qh: एक ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) एडेप्टर अणु के भीतर वे तीन बेस (triplet bases) कहाँ स्थित होते हैं जो mRNA कोडन के साथ प्रति-समानांतर रूप से जुड़ते हैं?
o: The terminal amino acid acceptor stem domain
The Anticodon loop (एंटीकोडन लूप / anticodon loop)
The unbranched non-ionic variable arm tail
The highly reactive internal dihydroxyuridine pocket
e: Explanation: The primary coding fidelity of a tRNA molecule relies on its anticodon loop. This structural domain houses three unique, solvent-exposed bases configured anti-parallelly to pair with a matching triplet codon along the mRNA template strand.

qe: What name is systematically assigned to describe the three-dimensional crystalline tertiary conformation of a functional tRNA molecule?
qh: एक कार्यात्मक ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) अणु के त्रि-आयामी (3D) तृतीयक विन्यास का वर्णन करने के लिए व्यवस्थित रूप से क्या नाम दिया गया है?
o: The symmetric clover-leaf secondary layout format
The compact inverted L-shaped configuration (उल्टा L-आकार)
The unbranched dicarboxylic straight alkane tail block
A cross-linked urea-formaldehyde polymer matrix sheet
e: Explanation: While two-dimensional representation yields a clover-leaf layout, physical X-ray diffraction tracking proves that tertiary folding constraints compress the functional tRNA molecule into a compact, inverted L-shaped configuration.

qe: What sequence coordinates the unique structural terminal layout displayed at the absolute 3' end of every functional tRNA amino acid acceptor stem?
qh: प्रत्येक कार्यात्मक tRNA एमीनो अम्ल स्वीकर्ता स्टेम के बिल्कुल 3' छोर पर प्रदर्शित होने वाले विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक अनुक्रम को कौन सा विन्यास समन्वित करता है?
o: A long lipophilic carbon chain containing chlorine atoms
The single-stranded 5'-CCA-3' hydroxyl sequence (5'-CCA-3' सिरा)
The automated AUG initiation codon sequence matrix
The non-coding polyadenylation tail array
e: Explanation: Every functional tRNA molecule finishes its 3' amino acid acceptor stem with a conserved single-stranded 5'-CCA-3' nucleotide layout. The terminal adenosine residue supplies the free hydroxyl group required to anchor an activated amino acid residue.

qe: What precise multi-protein cell assembly incorporates an siRNA strand to target and slice complementary mRNA molecules inside the cytoplasm?
qh: कौन सा जटिल सेलुलर मल्टीप्रोटीन असेंबली साइटोप्लाज्म के भीतर पूरक mRNA अणुओं को लक्षित करने और काटने के लिए एक siRNA स्ट्रैंड को शामिल करता है?
o: Ziegler-Natta coordination polymerization template system
RISC / RNA-Induced Silencing Complex (रिस्क कॉम्प्लेक्स / RISC)
The human spliceosome intron-cleaving network mapping model
A cross-linked urea-formaldehyde polymer matrix sheet
e: Explanation: In RNA interference (RNAi), small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) are integrated into a multi-protein assembly called the RNA-Induced Silencing Complex (RISC). RISC unwinds the siRNA, uses one strand as a guide to locate complementary mRNA, and cleaves it, blocking translation.

qe: The standardpotential of a classic Daniell cell is exactly 1.1 V. Which logarithmic mathematical expression correctly details its thermodynamic equilibrium state at 298 K?
qh: एक क्लासिक डेनियल सेल का मानक विभव बिल्कुल 1.1 V है। कौन सा लघुगणकीय गणितीय व्यंजक 298 K पर इसकी थर्मोडायनामिक संतुलन स्थिति का सही विवरण देता है?
o: $\log K_C = 1.1 \times 2F$
$\log K_C = \frac{2.2}{0.059}$ (डेनियल सेल संतुलन समीकरण)
$\log K_C = -1.1 \times nF$
$\log K_C = 1.1 \times 0.059$
e: Explanation: At chemical equilibrium, the Nernst equation simplifies to: $E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = \frac{0.059}{n}\log K_C$. For a Daniell cell, substituting $n = 2$ and $E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 1.1\text{ V}$ yields $1.1 = \frac{0.059}{2}\log K_C$, which rearranges directly to $\log K_C = \frac{2.2}{0.059}$.

qe: Which analytical milestone represents the primary separation driving force behind executing a Southern blotting verification procedure in molecular genetics?
qh: आणविक आनुवंशिकी में सदर्न ब्लॉटिंग (Southern blotting) सत्यापन प्रक्रिया को निष्पादित करने के पीछे प्राथमिक पृथक्करण चालक बल कौन सा है?
o: Fractional distillation based on boiling points of volatile ethers
Electrophoretic separation of DNA fragments by size across a gel matrix, followed by their structural transfer to a solid nylon membrane sheet (डीएनए टुकड़ों का जेल से नायलॉन झिल्ली पर स्थानांतरण)
The complete conversion of all target sugar backbones into unbranched polyolefins
The high pressure exclusion of cationic quaternary nitrogen components from buffer channels
e: Explanation: Southern blotting is a cornerstone molecular biology technique. It combines agarose gel electrophoresis (separating restricted DNA fragments purely by molecular size parameters) with a capillary transfer process that anchors these separated fragments onto a solid nitrocellulose or nylon membrane sheet for sequence-specific hybridization.

qe: What name is assigned to the physical status characterized by continuous erratic zig-zag path of colloidal particles inside a sol?
qh: एक सॉल के भीतर कोलाइडल कणों के निरंतर अनियमित टेढ़े-मेढ़े मार्ग (continuous erratic zig-zag path) की विशेषता वाली भौतिक स्थिति को क्या नाम दिया गया है?
o: Electrophoresis displacement lines
Brownian movement (ब्राउनियन गति)
Tyndall light diffraction layout
Coagulation network fixing zones
e: Explanation: Brownian motion is the continuous, erratic, zig-zag movement of colloidal particles suspended in a dispersion medium, driven by the constant kinetic bombardment from the liquid molecules.

qe: Which specific organic compound functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct a synthetic rubber elastomer like Neoprene?
qh: सिंथेटिक इलास्टोमर नियोप्रीन जैसे सिंथेटिक रबर का निर्माण करने के लिए आवश्यक मुख्य मोनोमर बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु कार्य करता है?
o: Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene)
Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene) (क्लोरोप्रीन मोनोमर)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) vinyl aromatic
e: Explanation: Neoprene is a durable synthetic rubber produced by the linear addition polymerization of chloroprene monomers, chemically designated as 2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene.

qe: What happens to the structure of linear Novolac strands if they are mixed with excess formaldehyde gas and subjected to high thermal curing?
qh: यदि रैखिक नोवोलेक स्ट्रैंड्स को अतिरिक्त फॉर्मलाडेहाइड गैस के साथ मिला जाए और उच्च थर्मल क्यूरिंग के अधीन किया जाए तो उनकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: They break down into volatile liquid phenols via hydrolytic cleavage
They develop extensive covalent methylene cross-links, transforming the linear resin into the rigid thermosetting network Bakelite (क्रॉस-लिंक्ड बैकेलाइट नेटवर्क)
They convert into an unbranched biodegradable polyester chain configuration
They form an explicit water-soluble uncharged non-ionic surfactant lattice balanced by sodium
e: Explanation: Novolac is a linear condensation intermediate. Heating Novolac with excess formaldehyde introduces methylene linkages that cross-link the chains into a permanent three-dimensional network, creating the infusible thermosetting polymer Bakelite.

qe: Which specific chemical bond forms the linkage that attaches a heterocyclic nitrogenous base to the C1' carbon position of a pentose sugar?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट रासायनिक बंध उस लिंकेज को बनाता है जो एक विषमचक्रीय नाइट्रोजनस बेस को पेंटोज शर्करा की C1' कार्बन स्थिति से जोड़ता है?
o: Phosphodiester linkage bridging sugar blocks
N-glycosidic linkage (N-ग्लाइकोसिडिक बंध)
Peptide linkage systematic covalent chain
Inter-chain Disulfide cross-link bridge system
e: Explanation: A nitrogenous base links covalently to the anomeric C1' position of a pentose sugar ring through an N-glycosidic bond, creating a nucleoside component configuration.

qe: What toxic crystalline compound is released into the human bloodstream when *Plasmodium* merozoites rupture erythrocytes, causing recurring chills and shivering?
qh: जब *Plasmodium* परजीवी मानव लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं को तोड़ते हैं, तो रक्तप्रवाह में कौन सा विषाक्त पदार्थ जारी होता है, जिससे कंपकंपी के साथ बार-बार बुखार आता है?
o: Serotonin alignment fluid
Haemozoin (हीमोजोइन)
Histamine inflammatory ester
Tannic acid chemical derivative
e: Explanation: The breakdown of blood hemoglobin by multiplying blood-stage parasites releases a toxic crystalline pigment known as haemozoin. This compound triggers the periodic chills and high recurring fevers characteristic of malaria.

qe: Which specific trio of fungal genera contains the primary pathogens responsible for causing ringworm infections in humans?
qh: कवक जेनेरा (fungal genera) के किस विशिष्ट तिकड़ी में मनुष्यों में दाद के संक्रमण के लिए जिम्मेदार प्राथमिक रोगजनक शामिल हैं?
o: Plasmodium, Entamoeba, and Ascaris groups
Microsporum, Trichophyton, and Epidermophyton (माइक्रोस्पोरम, ट्राइकोफाइटन एवं एपिडर्मोफाइटन)
Wuchereria, Bacillus, and Salmonella clusters
Rhizopus, Agaricus, and Saccharomyces variants
e: Explanation: Ringworm infections are caused by a group of dermatophyte fungi belonging to three primary genera: *Microsporum*, *Trichophyton*, and *Epidermophyton*.

qe: Why do individuals who are heterozygous ($Hb^A/Hb^S$) for the sickle-cell trait display a high survival rate in hyper-endemic malaria zones?
qh: सिकल-सेल लक्षण के लिए विषमयुग्मजी ($Hb^A/Hb^S$) व्यक्ति मलेरिया-स्थानिक क्षेत्रों में उच्च जीवित रहने की दर क्यों प्रदर्शित करते हैं?
o: Their erythrocytes continuously synthesize active toxic mineral chemical filters

The sickle-shaped distortion of their erythrocytes impairs the survival and propagation of *Plasmodium falciparum*, prompting targeted destruction of infected cells (प्लाज्मोडियम के गुणन में बाधा होना)
Their blood plasma contains permanent three-dimensional cross-linked polyamide networks
The mutation decreases the required concentration of current-carrying ions down to zero
e: Explanation: Individuals heterozygous for the sickle-cell trait ($Hb^A/Hb^S$) display natural resistance against severe malaria. The structural premature distortion of infected sickle-type red blood cells prevents the parasite *Plasmodium falciparum* from completing its growth cycle, leading to the early destruction of infected erythrocytes.

qe: How do tissue-specific pathogens effectively survive and establish infections inside the highly hostile micro-environment of the human stomach?
qh: ऊतक-विशिष्ट रोगजनक (tissue-specific pathogens) मानव पेट के अत्यधिक प्रतिकूल सूक्ष्म वातावरण के भीतर प्रभावी ढंग से कैसे जीवित रहते हैं?
o: They transform their surrounding proteins into volatile open-chain non-polar gases
They undergo adaptational shifts to resist low gastric pH conditions and withstand aggressive digestive enzymes (कम pH और पाचक एंजाइमों के प्रति अनुकूलन)
They compile a permanent rigid coordinate cross-linked outer resin network
They rely completely on free-radical addition kinetics to alter cell membranes
e: Explanation: Pathogens targeting the human digestive tract possess specific biochemical adaptations that protect them from host defenses, allowing them to survive the extreme acidity ($ ext{pH} \sim 1.5-2.0$) of stomach juices and resist proteolytic enzymes.

qe: An immunocompromised patient screens positive during an Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA). Which pairing correctly maps the pathology and target cells destroyed by this virus?
qh: एक प्रतिरक्षाविहीन रोगी का ELISA परीक्षण सकारात्मक आता है। कौन सा युग्म इस वायरस द्वारा नष्ट की गई विकृति और लक्षित कोशिकाओं को सही ढंग से दर्शाता है?
o: Pneumonia destroying alveolar epithelial wall spaces
AIDS caused by HIV, selectively destroying macrophages and Helper T-lymphocytes (एड्स रोग; मैक्रोफेज एवं हेल्पर टी-कोशिकाओं का नष्ट होना)
Amoebiasis targeting the muscular layers of the large intestine
Filariasis disrupting the non-ionic surfactant layers of lower limbs
e: Explanation: A positive ELISA screen combined with severe immunosuppression points to Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS) caused by HIV. The virus infects and destroys host immune cells displaying CD4 surface receptors, primarily targeting macrophages and helper T-lymphocytes ($T_H$ cells).

qe: What primary operational parameter distinguishes B-lymphocytes from T-lymphocytes inside human adaptive defense infrastructure?
qh: मानव अनुकूलन रक्षा बुनियादी ढांचे के भीतर बी-लिम्फोसाइटों (B-lymphocytes) को टी-लिम्फोसाइटों (T-lymphocytes) से कौन सा प्राथमिक परिचालन पैरामीटर अलग करता है?
o: B-cells isolate passing nitrogen atoms from red cell groups entirely

B-cells mature inside the bone marrow and synthesize circulating antibodies, while T-cells mature in the thymus and execute cell-mediated immunity (B-कोशिकाएं एंटीबॉडी बनाती हैं, T-कोशिकाएं कोशिका-माध्यस्थता प्रतिरक्षा प्रदान करती हैं)
B-cells possess an extensive three-dimensional cross-linked phenolic matrix structure
B-cells transform target antigens into volatile open-chain non-polar gases
e: Explanation: B-lymphocytes mature within the bone marrow and drive humoral immunity by secreting specific, circulating antibodies into bodily fluids. T-lymphocytes mature within the thymus gland and drive cell-mediated immunity, directly attacking target cells or assisting B-cells.

qe: What chronic pathological symptom defines the tissue damage caused by filarial roundworm parasites like *Wuchereria bancrofti*?
qh: फाइलेरिया कृमि जैसे *Wuchereria bancrofti* के कारण होने वाले ऊतक क्षति को कौन सा पुराना लक्षण परिभाषित करता है?
o: The rapid structural conversion of lung tissues into amorphous oils
Slowly developing chronic inflammation and swelling of lower limb lymphatic vessels, causing elephantiasis (हाथीपांव या लसीका वाहिकाओं की पुरानी सूजन)
The complete temporary loss of all primary sugar-phosphate backbone lines
Spontaneous free-radical addition transformations inside the stomach lining
e: Explanation: Filarial worms like *Wuchereria bancrofti* live inside the human lymphatic system for years. They block lymph fluid drainage, driving chronic inflammation and connective tissue hypertrophy that leads to the swelling of lower limbs known as elephantiasis.

qe: What serious immunogenic hazard occurs inside human somatic environments if the primary primary thymus gland is surgically removed?
qh: यदि मानव शरीर से प्राथमिक थाइमस ग्रंथि (thymus gland) को शल्य चिकित्सा द्वारा हटा दिया जाए तो कौन सा गंभीर खतरा उत्पन्न होता है?
o: The system initiates the immediate common-ion precipitation of all plasma proteins

The differentiation and maturation of T-lymphocytes halts, severely weakening cell-mediated immunity and making the host vulnerable to infections (T-लिम्फोसाइटों का परिपक्वता रुकना और प्रतिरक्षा कमजोर होना)
The bone marrow shifts into an unbranched biodegradable polyester line framework
The entire somatic network undergoes spontaneous conversion into volatile gases
e: Explanation: The thymus gland is the primary site for T-lymphocyte maturation and selection. Removing it destroys the body's ability to produce mature, antigen-sensitive T-cells, severely compromising cell-mediated immunity and leaving the host vulnerable to opportunistic infections.

qe: Which unique functional pairing correctly lists the physiological and chemical barriers that protect the human gastrointestinal tract from ingested microbial pathogens?
qh: कौन सा अनूठा कार्यात्मक युग्म उन शारीरिक और रासायनिक बाधाओं को सही ढंग से सूचीबद्ध करता है जो मानव पाचन तंत्र को खाए गए रोगजनकों से बचाते हैं?
o: The epidermal layer fields combined directly with cartilage rings
The protective mucus coating of the epithelium lining and the highly acidic gastric juice of the stomach (श्लेष्मा परत और पेट का अत्यधिक अम्लीय हाइड्रोक्लोरिक रस)
The non-ionic linear surfactants balanced across the cellular bilipids
The cross-linked network layers compiled around quaternary nitrogen centers
e: Explanation: The human digestive tract is protected by innate barriers. The mucosal epithelium traps passing microorganisms, while the high acidity ($ ext{pH} \sim 1.5-2.0$) of gastric juices kills most ingested bacteria, establishing a biochemical barrier.

qe: What precise macro length profile describes the total extended linear dimension of genomic DNA packed inside a single diploid human cell?
qh: एक एकल द्विगुणित (diploid) मानव कोशिका के भीतर पैक किए गए जीनोमिक डीएनए के कुल विस्तारित रैखिक आयाम का क्या माप है?
o: 1.36 millimeters exactly
Approximately 2.2 meters (लगभग 2.2 मीटर)
34 nanometers calculated boundary
5386 micrometers metric scale
e: Explanation: Multiplying the total base pairs in a diploid human cell ($6.6 \times 10^9$) by the inter-pair distance ($0.34 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$) shows that the total linear length of DNA packed within a single cell nucleus is approximately 2.2 meters.

qe: What total extended linear dimension characterizes the circular genomic DNA payload packed inside a single cell of *Escherichia coli*?
qh: *Escherichia coli* की एक एकल कोशिका के भीतर पैक किए गए गोलाकार जीनोमिक डीएनए पेलोड की कुल विस्तारित रैखिक लंबाई क्या है?
o: 2.2 meters absolute length profile
Approximately 1.36 millimeters (लगभग 1.36 मिलीमीटर)
34 centimeters calculated index
5386 nanometers unbranched grid
e: Explanation: Multiplying the *E. coli* genome size ($4.6 \times 10^6\text{ base pairs}$) by the inter-pair spacing interval ($0.34 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$) shows that its circular chromosome has an extended linear length of approximately 1.36 millimeters.

qe: What unique capability allows the Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee (GEAC) to protect public safety across India?
qh: कौन सी अनूठी क्षमता जेनेटिक इंजीनियरिंग अप्रेजल कमेटी (GEAC) को पूरे भारत में सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा की रक्षा करने की अनुमति देती है?
o: It can permanently dissolve industrial polymer assets using acids
It evaluates the biosafety and legal validity of all genetic modification research and GM crop field trials before public release (जीएम अनुसंधान की वैधता और सुरक्षा का मूल्यांकन करना)
It regulates the free-radical polymerization kinetics of commercial plastics
It converts open-chain carbohydrate matrices into volatile non-polar gases
e: Explanation: The GEAC is India's apex regulatory body for biotechnology. It is legally empowered to evaluate the environmental safety, biosafety parameters, and validity of genetic modification research and large-scale field trials before approving any GMO for public or commercial use.

qe: Which specific organic compound is generated when D-glucose undergoes complete chemical reduction using hydrogen iodide ($HI$) under thermal conditions?
qh: जब D-ग्लूकोज थर्मल स्थितियों के तहत हाइड्रोजन आयोडाइड ($HI$) का उपयोग करके पूर्ण रासायनिक अपचयन से गुजरता है तो कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक उत्पन्न होता है?
o: Saccharic acid containing terminal dicarboxylic groups
n-Hexane unbranched straight-chain alkane (n-हेक्सेन)
Gluconic acid monocarboxylic derivative sheet
Pentaacetylated glucose crystal matrix
e: Explanation: Subjecting D-glucose to long-term heating with concentrated hydrogen iodide ($HI$) fully reduces all oxygenated centers along the molecule, converting the carbohydrate into an unbranched six-carbon alkane known as n-hexane.

qe: What happens to the structure of a carbohydrate like starch or cellulose when it undergoes complete biochemical digestion in a living organism?
qh: जब एक जीवित जीव में स्टार्च या सेलुलोज जैसे कार्बोहाइड्रेट का पूर्ण जैव रासायनिक पाचन होता है तो उसकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: It cross-links into an insoluble three-dimensional thermosetting network
It undergoes hydrolytic cleavage of its glycosidic linkages to release single monosaccharide sugar units like glucose (मोनोसैकेराइड इकाइयों में जलअपघटन होना)
It converts into fuming nitric acid vapors inside cellular channels
It forms a volatile uncharged non-polar polyolefin tail grid
e: Explanation: Polysaccharides are broken down through enzyme-catalyzed hydrolysis. This process cleaves the chemical glycosidic links between individual rings, converting the macro-carbohydrate back into single monosaccharide components (such as D-glucose) for cellular respiration.

qe: Which specific organic functional group connection links consecutive monosaccharide units together to build high molecular weight polysaccharides like starch and cellulose?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक कार्यात्मक समूह कनेक्शन लगातार मोनोसेकेराइड कोशिकाओं को एक साथ जोड़कर स्टार्च और सेलुलोज जैसे उच्च आणविक भार वाले पॉलीसेकेराइड का निर्माण करता है?
o: Peptide linkage holding amino residues together
Glycosidic linkage (ग्लाइकोसिडिक बंध)
Phosphodiester bridging matrix channel crossing sugar blocks
Disulfide cross-link sulfur bridge system anchoring lines
e: Explanation: Monosaccharide rings couple via condensation reactions to build complex carbohydrates. The resulting carbon-oxygen-carbon covalent connection linking the rings is termed a glycosidic linkage.

qe: What is the correct mathematical expression used to calculate the degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte from its molar conductivity values?
qh: अमीनो एसिड या इलेक्ट्रोलाइट मानों से कमजोर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट के विघटन की डिग्री ($\alpha$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला सही गणितीय व्यंजक क्या है?
o: $\alpha = \Lambda_m \cdot \Lambda_m^\circ$
$\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$ (विघटन की डिग्री सूत्र)
$\alpha = \frac{\kappa \cdot 1000}{M}$
$\alpha = nF E^\circ_{cell}$
e: Explanation: The degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte at a specific concentration is calculated as the ratio of its molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) to its limiting molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$): $\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$.

qe: What architectural term defines the maximum bounding value of molar conductivity achieved when the concentration of an electrolyte approaches exactly zero?
qh: जब किसी इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सांद्रता बिल्कुल शून्य के करीब पहुँचती है तो प्राप्त मोलर चालकता के अधिकतम सीमा मान को कौन सा शब्द परिभाषित करता है?
o: Anomeric intermediate potential
Limiting Molar Conductivity (अनंत तनुता पर मोलर चालकता - \Lambda_m^\circ)
Unbranched non-ionic resistance matrix
Cross-linked network conductivity index
e: Explanation: When dilution is carried out to an infinite degree and concentration approaches zero, the molar conductivity reaches a maximum limiting value termed the Limiting Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$).

qe: What direct mechanical change occurs to the native protein architecture inside an egg white when it undergoes thermal coagulation upon boiling?
qh: जब एक अंडे की सफेदी को उबालने पर थर्मल जमावट (thermal coagulation) होती है, तो उसके भीतर की प्राकृतिक प्रोटीन संरचना में क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The covalent peptide linkages are broken, returning the protein to single units
The native hydrogen bonds are disrupted, causing structural globules to unfold and helices to uncoil, resulting in a loss of biological activity (विकृतीकरण या डिनेचुरेशन)
The carbon backbone converts into a volatile open-chain gas cloud
The functional domains are reduced to non-ionic starch granules
e: Explanation: Boiling an egg white introduces thermal stress that disrupts non-covalent hydrogen bonds and structural constraints. This causes the folded globular proteins to uncoil and denature, cross-linking randomly into an insoluble white mass.

qe: What descriptive terminology defines the unique architectural feature of the genetic code known as 'degeneracy'?
qh: 'अपभ्रष्टता' (degeneracy) के रूप में जाने जाने वाले आनुवंशिक कोड की अनूठी संरचनात्मक विशेषता को क्या शब्दावली परिभाषित करती है?
o: A single codon can simultaneously code for multiple different amino acids
A single amino acid can be specified and coded by more than one distinct codon (एक से अधिक कोडन द्वारा एक अमीनो अम्ल का कोडिंग)
The codons turn completely volatile and drop down to zero value metrics
The genetic dictionary changes properties dynamically based on solution pressure
e: Explanation: The genetic code is redundant or degenerate. Because there are 61 amino-acid-specifying codons but only 20 standard amino acids, many amino acids are specified by more than one distinct codon (e.g., phenylalanine is targeted by both UUU and UUC).

qe: Which specific initiation codon serves the dual role of initiating translation while coding for the amino acid methionine?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट दीक्षा कोडन (initiation codon) अमीनो एसिड मेथिओनिन के लिए कोडिंग करते हुए अनुवाद शुरू करने की दोहरी भूमिका निभाता है?
o: UUU phenylalanine code
AUG codon (AUG कोडन)
UAA ochre terminator factor
UGA opel stop marker segment
e: Explanation: The triplet codon AUG plays a dual role in molecular genetics: it codes for the essential amino acid methionine and serves as the universal initiation marker that establishes the reading frame for ribosomes.

qe: Which functional pairing correctly lists the classic nonsense or 'stop' codons that terminate polypeptide chain synthesis?
qh: कौन सा कार्यात्मक युग्म क्लासिक नॉनसेंस या 'स्टॉप' कोडन (stop codons) को सही ढंग से सूचीबद्ध करता है जो पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला संश्लेषण को समाप्त करते हैं?
o: AUG, GUG, and UUU initiation entries
UAA, UAG, and UGA (UAA, UAG एवं UGA स्टॉप कोडन)
GAA, GAG, and GUG alternative blocks
CCA, CCC, and CCG structural segments
e: Explanation: Three codons do not code for any amino acid residues. Named nonsense or stop codons, the triplet arrangements UAA (ochre), UAG (amber), and UGA (opal) signal release factors to terminate translation.

qe: What name is assigned to the regions of an mRNA molecule that are situated before the start codon and after the stop codon, which are essential for translation efficiency?
qh: एक mRNA अणु के उन क्षेत्रों को क्या नाम दिया गया है जो स्टार्ट कोडन से पहले और स्टॉप कोडन के बाद स्थित होते हैं, जो अनुवाद दक्षता के लिए आवश्यक हैं?
o: Exon coding domains
Untranslated Regions / UTRs (अननुवादित क्षेत्र / UTRs)
Cistronic overlapping fields
Polyamide structural link sets
e: Explanation: Messenger RNA molecules contain sequences flanking the coding frame: located before the start codon at the 5'-end and after the stop codon at the 3'-end, these non-translated segments are designated as Untranslated Regions (UTRs) and are vital for translation efficiency.

qe: What direct physical consequence characterizes a point mutation, differentiating it from an extensive frame-shift mutation?
qh: कौन सा प्रत्यक्ष भौतिक परिणाम एक बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन (point mutation) की विशेषता है, जो इसे व्यापक फ्रेम-शिफ्ट उत्परिवर्तन से अलग करता है?
o: The entire macromolecule cross-links into an insoluble solid net layer
A change involving the substitution of a single base pair inside the DNA sequence (एकल क्षारक युग्म में परिवर्तन)
The automatic loss of all nitrogen bases across the targeted cistron
The sudden volatilization of the sugar phosphate framework profile
e: Explanation: A point mutation is a genetic change that involves the substitution of a single nucleotide base pair within a DNA sequence, as seen in sickle-cell anemia, distinct from multi-base insertions or deletions that disrupt the reading frame.

qe: What unique structural molecule acts as the physical adapter that carries specific amino acids to coordinate with matching codons along an mRNA template?
qh: कौन सा अनूठा संरचनात्मक अणु भौतिक एडेप्टर (adapter) के रूप में कार्य करता है जो एक mRNA टेम्पलेट के साथ मिलान कोडन के साथ समन्वय करने के लिए विशिष्ट अमीनो एसिड ले जाता है?
o: Ribosomal structural component matrix
Transfer RNA / tRNA / Adapter RNA (अंतरण आरएनए / tRNA)
Heterogeneous nuclear transcript block
Linear step-growth polyamide string segment
e: Explanation: Transfer RNA (tRNA) serves as an adapter molecule. It contains an anti-codon loop that reads and pairs with complementary codons along the mRNA template and an amino acid acceptor stem that carries the corresponding amino acid residue.

qe: What name is assigned to describe the two-dimensional folded layout model of a transfer RNA (tRNA) molecule?
qh: ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) अणु के द्वि-आयामी मुड़े हुए लेआउट मॉडल का वर्णन करने के लिए क्या मैक्रो नाम दिया गया है?
o: Inverted L-shape layout framework
Clover-leaf structure (क्लोवर-लीफ / तिपतिया घास की पत्ती जैसी संरचना)
Linear unbranched polysaccharide matrix sheet
Thermosetting cross-linked network model mesh
e: Explanation: In two dimensions, the secondary folding structure of a tRNA molecule folds into loops and arms resembling a clover-leaf blueprint. In three dimensions, it folds into a compact inverted L-shape configuration.

qe: What unique capability allows the Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee (GEAC) to protect public safety across India?
qh: कौन सी अनूठी क्षमता जेनेटिक इंजीनियरिंग अप्रेजल कमेटी (GEAC) को पूरे भारत में सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा की रक्षा करने की अनुमति देती है?
o: It can permanently dissolve industrial polymer assets using acids
It evaluates the biosafety and legal validity of all genetic modification research and GM crop field trials before public release (जीएम अनुसंधान की वैधता और सुरक्षा का मूल्यांकन करना)
It regulates the free-radical polymerization kinetics of commercial plastics
It converts open-chain carbohydrate matrices into volatile non-polar gases
e: Explanation: The GEAC is India's apex regulatory body for biotechnology. It is legally empowered to evaluate the environmental safety, biosafety parameters, and validity of genetic modification research and large-scale field trials before approving any GMO for public or commercial use.

qe: Which specific organic compound functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct a synthetic rubber elastomer like Neoprene?
qh: सिंथेटिक इलास्टोमर नियोप्रीन जैसे सिंथेटिक रबर का निर्माण करने के लिए आवश्यक मुख्य मोनोमर बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु कार्य करता है?
o: Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene)
Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene) (क्लोरोप्रीन मोनोमर)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) vinyl aromatic
e: Explanation: Neoprene is a durable synthetic rubber produced by the linear addition polymerization of chloroprene monomers, chemically designated as 2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene.

qe: What happens to the structure of linear Novolac strands if they are mixed with excess formaldehyde gas and subjected to high thermal curing?
qh: यदि रैखिक नोवोलेक स्ट्रैंड्स को अतिरिक्त फॉर्मलाडेहाइड गैस के साथ मिलाया जाए और उच्च थर्मल क्यूरिंग के अधीन किया जाए तो उनकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: They break down into volatile liquid phenols via hydrolytic cleavage
They develop extensive covalent methylene cross-links, transforming the linear resin into the rigid thermosetting network Bakelite (क्रॉस-लिंक्ड बैकेलाइट नेटवर्क)
They convert into an unbranched biodegradable polyester chain configuration
They form an explicit water-soluble uncharged non-ionic surfactant lattice balanced by sodium
e: Explanation: Novolac is a linear condensation intermediate. Heating Novolac with excess formaldehyde introduces methylene linkages that cross-link the chains into a permanent three-dimensional network, creating the infusible thermosetting polymer Bakelite.

qe: What structural unit remains after a nucleotide monomer loses its terminal esterified phosphate group?
qh: एक न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर जब अपने एस्टरीकृत फॉस्फेट समूह को खो देता है, तो कौन सी संरचनात्मक इकाई शेष बचती है?
o: A volatile aliphatic open-chain non-polar gas matrix
Nucleoside (न्यूक्लिओसाइड)
An active free-radical addition polymer initiator
A cross-linked three-dimensional network panel
e: Explanation: A nucleoside contains only a pentose sugar linked to a nitrogenous base. Adding a phosphate group to its 5'-position transforms it into a full nucleotide.

qe: Which strong covalent bond connects consecutive nucleotide monomers together along a single strand of DNA or RNA?
qh: कौन सा मजबूत सहसंयोजक बंध डीएनए या आरएनए के एक एकल धागे (single strand) के साथ लगातार न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर्स को एक साथ जोड़ता है?
o: N-glycosidic link bridging rings together
3'-5' phosphodiester linkage (3'-5' फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध)
Amide linkage systematically identical to a biological peptide bond
Sulfur disulfide cross-link bridge system anchoring paths
e: Explanation: Nucleotides fold sequentially into polymers via 3'-5' phosphodiester linkages. This covalent bridge connects the 3'-hydroxyl group of one pentose sugar to the 5'-phosphate group of the next nucleotide.

qe: What molecular architectural arrangement details the relative directionality of the two complementary strands inside a DNA double helix model?
qh: कौन सा आणविक संरचनात्मक विन्यास डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स मॉडल के भीतर दो पूरक धागों की सापेक्ष दिशात्मकता (relative directionality) का विवरण देता है?
o: They run parallel in the exact same 5' to 3' spatial direction
They exhibit anti-parallel polarity, where one strand runs 5' to 3' and the other runs 3' to 5' (प्रति-समानांतर ध्रुवता / anti-parallel)
They are arranged as separate open-chain unlinked carbohydrate blocks
They cross-link randomly into a single infusible thermosetting net plastic
e: Explanation: The twin strands of a DNA double helix run anti-parallel to one another. One strand is oriented in the 5' to 3' direction, while its complementary counter-strand features a reverse 3' to 5' alignment.

qe: Which specific inter-chain bond stabilizes base pairing across the complementary strands of a DNA double helix?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट अंतर-श्रृंखला बंध डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स के पूरक धागों में क्षारक युग्मन (base pairing) को स्थिर करता है?
o: Strong phosphodiester covalent bridges
Hydrogen bonds established between complementary purines and pyrimidines (हाइड्रोजन बंध)
Covalent peptide linkages identical to those in globular proteins
Quaternary ammonium halide coordinate link systems
e: Explanation: Base pairing between anti-parallel strands is stabilized by hydrogen bonds between complementary purine and pyrimidine bases (A pairs with T via two bonds; G pairs with C via three bonds).

qe: How many hydrogen bonds form the complementary pairing between adenine and thymine bases inside a double-stranded DNA block?
qh: डबल-स्ट्रैंडेड डीएनए ब्लॉक के भीतर एडेनीन और थायमीन बेस के बीच पूरक युग्मन (complementary pairing) कितने हाइड्रोजन बंध बनाते हैं?
o: Three hydrogen bonds configuration
Two hydrogen bonds (दो हाइड्रोजन बंध)
A single irreversible covalent bridge
Four quaternary coordinate networks
e: Explanation: Adenine couples specifically to thymine across anti-parallel strands through exactly two stable hydrogen bonds ($A = T$).

qe: What quantitative count of hydrogen bonds stabilizes the specific pairing interface between guanine and cytosine bases in DNA?
qh: डीएनए में ग्वानीन और साइटोसिन बेस के बीच विशिष्ट युग्मन इंटरफ़ेस को हाइड्रोजन बंधों की कौन सी मात्रात्मक संख्या स्थिर करती है?
o: Two hydrogen bonds configuration
Three hydrogen bonds (तीन हाइड्रोजन बंध)
One extensive covalent bridge
Zero net thermodynamic bonds
e: Explanation: Guanine coordinates to cytosine along complementary strands via three hydrogen bonds ($G \equiv C$), making GC-rich regions thermodynamically robust.

qe: What is the physical pitch dimension of a single complete turn of a classic B-DNA double helix under standard structural configurations?
qh: मानक संरचनात्मक विन्यासों के तहत क्लासिक B-DNA डबल हेलिक्स के एक एकल पूर्ण मोड़ का भौतिक पिच आयाम (pitch dimension) क्या है?
o: 0.34 nanometers absolute width
3.4 nanometers (3.4 नैनोमीटर)
34 nanometers extensive length
2.2 meters absolute macro profile
e: Explanation: In a standard B-DNA model, one full helical turn (pitch) spans a spatial length of 3.4 nanometers ($34\text{ \AA}$) along the axis.

qe: What is the structural spacing interval calculated between consecutive base pairs along the vertical axis of a Scholar double helix?
qh: मानक B-DNA डबल हेलिक्स के ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष के साथ लगातार क्षारक युग्मों के बीच की दूरी (structural spacing) क्या है?
o: 3.4 nanometers total length
0.34 nanometers (0.34 नैनोमीटर)
20 nanometers structural area width
4.6 nanometers calculated index
e: Explanation: Since a single helical turn has a pitch of 3.4 nm and accommodates exactly ten base pairs, the calculated spacing interval between consecutive base pairs is $3.4/10 = 0.34\text{ nm}$ ($3.4\text{ \AA}$).

qe: What core mathematical formula used to calculate the Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of an amino solution from specific values?
qh: मानक प्रयोगशाला इकाइयों में समाधान की विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) और मोलरिटी ($M$) से उसकी मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला मुख्य गणितीय सूत्र क्या है?
o: $\Lambda_m = \frac{M \cdot \kappa}{1000}$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$ (मोलर चालकता सूत्र)
$\Lambda_m = \kappa \cdot G^*$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa \cdot R}{M}$
e: Explanation: When conductivity $\kappa$ is measured in $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ and concentration $M$ is in $\text{mol/L}$, the molar conductivity is calculated using the formula: $\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$.

qe: The single-stranded backbones of DNA and RNA molecules are constructed by linking successive nucleotides via which strong covalent bonds?
qh: DNA और RNA अणुओं की एकल-स्ट्रैंडेड रीढ़ क्रमिक न्यूक्लियोटाइड को किस मजबूत सहसंयोजक बंध द्वारा जोड़कर बनाई जाती है?
o: Glycosidic connections bridging sugar rings together
Phosphodiester linkages (फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध / लिंक)
Methylene amide coordinate connection networks across strands
Disulfide cross-link bridges pulling hydrocarbon chain links
e: Explanation: The backbones of DNA and RNA are compiled by connecting successive nucleotides via strong covalent phosphodiester bonds that link the C5' position of one pentose ring to the C3' position of the next.

qe: Which specific organic compound functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct the natural rubber elastomer chain?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु प्राकृतिक रबर इलास्टोमर श्रृंखला के निर्माण के लिए आवश्यक बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene)
Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene) (आइसोप्रीन)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) vinyl aromatic
e: Explanation: Natural rubber is a homopolymer of isoprene. Under systematic IUPAC rules, isoprene is designated as 2-methylbuta-1,3-diene.

qe: What direct mechanical change occurs to the native protein architecture inside an egg white when it undergoes thermal coagulation upon boiling?
qh: जब एक अंडे की सफेदी को उबालने पर थर्मल जमावट (thermal coagulation) होती है, तो उसके भीतर की प्राकृतिक प्रोटीन संरचना में क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The covalent peptide linkages are broken, returning the protein to single units
The native hydrogen bonds are disrupted, causing structural globules to unfold and helices to uncoil, resulting in a loss of biological activity (विकृतीकरण या डिनेचुरेशन)
The carbon backbone converts into a volatile open-chain gas cloud
The functional domains are reduced to non-ionic starch granules
e: Explanation: Boiling an egg white introduces thermal stress that disrupts non-covalent hydrogen bonds and structural constraints. This causes the folded globular proteins to uncoil and denature, cross-linking randomly into an insoluble white mass.

qe: Why can prolonged exposure to passive or second-hand smoking be equally as hazardous to human respiratory infrastructure as active smoking?
qh: निष्क्रिय धूम्रपान (passive smoking) सक्रिय धूम्रपान के समान ही खतरनाक क्यों हो सकता है?
o: It converts surrounding nitrogen pools into volatile industrial compounds
It exposes non-smokers to the same harmful chemical particles, triggering excessive mucus release that can block airways and drive emphysema (वही हानिकारक प्रभाव होना और वायुमार्ग अवरुद्ध करना)
It establishes a permanent three-dimensional cross-linked polyamide matrix on the skin
It forces cellular sugars to lose their ionizable phosphate backbones instantly
e: Explanation: Passive smoking involves inhaling the secondary smoke suspended in surrounding air. This smoke contains identical harmful chemical carcinogens and irritants as active smoke, which can trigger excess mucus production in the bronchioles, obstruct airways, and lead to chronic bronchitis, emphysema, or lung cancer.

qe: Which specific parameter does not represent a long-term debilitating or negative lifestyle consequence associated with chronic non-infectious diseases?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मापदंड पुरानी गैर-संक्रामक बीमारियों (chronic non-infectious diseases) से जुड़ा दीर्घकालिक नकारात्मक परिणाम नहीं है?
o: Extensive permanent structural damage to vital internal organs
The complete conversion of blood plasma into stable non-polar polyolefin liquids (रक्त प्लाज्मा का पॉलियोलेफिन में बदलना सत्य नहीं है)
Severe chronic mental and psychological distress for the patient
